tasks.title: Create Invoice entity + migration
tasks.notes: Fields: id, invoiceNumber (unique index), orderId (FK), storeId, status, issuedAt, lines (JSONB snapshot), vatSubtotals (JSONB), totalBeforeVatVnd, totalVatVnd, totalWithVatVnd. DB SEQUENCE for invoiceNumber per store-year.

tasks.title: Implement InvoiceModule: auto-generate on OrderCompletedEvent
tasks.notes: Listen on OrderCompletedEvent. Create invoice in 'draft', persist, set status='issued', then update order.status='completed'. All in one DB transaction. Retry on failure, max 3 times.

tasks.title: Implement VAT calculation logic: group by taxRatePercent, floor rounding
tasks.notes: vatVnd = Math.floor(taxableVnd * rate / 100). Group order items by taxRatePercent. Must be isolated as a pure utility for unit testing.

tasks.title: Implement invoiceNumber sequence: per-store per-year, gap-free
tasks.notes: Use PostgreSQL SEQUENCE or table-based sequence with FOR UPDATE lock. Format: '{YYYY}/{seq:06d}'. Reset on year change.

tasks.title: Implement GET /orders/:id/invoice
tasks.notes: Returns invoice for a specific order. 404 if order not completed.

tasks.title: Implement PATCH /invoices/:id/cancel (accountant only, after refund)
tasks.notes: Validates order is in 'refunded' state before cancelling invoice. Idempotent.

tasks.title: Write unit tests: VAT calculation logic
tasks.notes: Pure function. Cover: all VAT rates, mixed rates in one order, floor rounding edge cases, 0% rate.

tasks.title: Write integration tests: create order → confirm payment → invoice generated
tasks.notes: End-to-end happy path. Cover: invoice number uniqueness under concurrent requests.

tasks.title: Frontend: Invoice viewer page (cashier + accountant)
tasks.notes: Show invoice number, store info, line items, VAT subtotals, total. Print-friendly layout.

tasks.title: Frontend: Invoice list page for accountant
tasks.notes: Date range picker, status filter, export to CSV (Sprint 4 — deferred).
